rule: A point the TEXT defines by a W18 §16.1 relation (midpoint, 'lần lượt' midpoints, projection/foot) is a consequence the kernel must construct. When the program defines that point by coordinates (declare_point / initial_value, with or without model_assumption or source_fact_id), the relation is not realized by any construction, and equal coordinates are never identity evidence: the request must be refused. The refusal must not tell the learner the problem text is wrong (refusal_cause != SOURCE). Layout literals of points without such a relation are untouched. No vocabulary is added: only relations the §16.1 reader already reads are in scope.
